logline: When three lantern towers go dark, a mapmaker and the old lantern keeper climb into the dry canal and find a signal that is not a lamp.

shots.camera: slow drift right over the rooftops
shots.action: Lanterns flicker on one by one across the sandstone roofs as the sun sets.
Ayla sprints across a rooftop with a map tube bouncing on her back.
Ayla stops at the ledge, out of breath, pointing west.

lines.speaker: Ayla
lines.text: Tariq! The west line went dark. Three towers, all at once.

shots.action: Tariq holds the green lantern up to the wind, eyes narrowed.

lines.speaker: Tariq
lines.text: Not dark. Hidden. Someone is drawing the lamps down into the canal.

shots.action: Ayla and Tariq look west at the three dark towers.

lines.speaker: Tariq
lines.text: Then we will go and ask the echoes.

scenes.title: The lantern that never went out

shots.action: Tariq's hands light a second lantern from the green one; the glass hums.
Tariq watches the flame, face lit green.

lines.speaker: Tariq
lines.text: My grandfather lit this one the night the river left. It has never gone out.

shots.action: Ayla unrolls her map on the stair; three lanterns on it are crossed out.

lines.speaker: Tariq
lines.text: Then the city forgets where it is.

shots.action: Moonlight on puddles in the cracked canal; two small figures climb down.
Ayla's compass needle spins, then points down the tunnel.

lines.speaker: Ayla
lines.text: It is pointing at something that is not north.

shots.action: Far down the canal a faint green glow blinks twice as Tariq raises his lantern.

lines.speaker: Tariq
lines.text: That is not a lamp. That is a signal.
